description: Stage 4 / CODEX P0.1: combined ability+trait beforeTurn on the SAME Pokemon -- Slakoth's Truant (ability, generic beforeTurn) and sword_charm (trait, generic beforeTurn) merged together. True JS order is ability-first-then-traits (mergeBattleConfigs(O=ability, iu=traits), bundle.deobfuscated.js:80991-81015), both fire for their side effects (Truant's alternating-loaf counter still flips; sword_charm's one-shot +4 Atk still applies), but BOTH configs' 'skip' returns are discarded -- so Slakoth attacks on every single round from round 1 onward, never loafing, on top of gaining sword_charm's +4 Atk once. This is the fixture that would catch a merge implementation that gets discard-semantics right but call-order wrong (traits-then-ability instead of ability-then-traits).
